# Talaix

> Talaix is a natural-hazard and climate-extreme intelligence platform for
> every sector: it turns Earth observation, environmental data and historical
> events into documented, traceable evidence on lives at risk and money at
> stake around any asset, place or territory — for governments, municipalities,
> investors, banks, insurers and reinsurers.
> Honesty contract: unavailable data is declared, never invented; every
> claim carries an evidence status (OBSERVED / DOCUMENTED / REPORTED /
> MODELLED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN).

## Product pages

- [Insurance & Environmental Risk](https://talaix.com/insurance.html): per-peril levels + long-term event history for underwriters and reinsurers (no loss quantification)
- [Investment & Siting Intelligence](https://talaix.com/intelligence.html): multi-hazard screening, exposure and evidence for financial decisions, plus site-fitted resilience solutions (`?mode=siting`) and matched public funding programmes (`?mode=funding`) — one window
- [Maps](https://talaix.com/map.html): interactive risk layers with source and confidence shown for every layer
- [Reports & Evidence Packs](https://talaix.com/reports.html): Insurance, Green Finance, Sustainability/CSRD, Sector Exposure, Forensics, Supply Chain, Press and Report Builder
- [Pricing](https://talaix.com/pricing.html): free tier, pay-per-use reports (Decision €19, Scientific €39), Professional (€49/mo or €490/yr), Business (€249/mo or €2,490/yr), Government and Enterprise contracts
- [Environmental Licensing](https://talaix.com/licensing.html): pre-draft licence dossiers backed by satellite evidence
- [Compliance & Sustainable Finance](https://talaix.com/compliance.html): EU Taxonomy DNSH, EBA Pillar 3, CSRD/ESRS E1, EIOPA/Solvency II, EUDR
- [Green Finance Verification](https://talaix.com/green-finance.html): per-asset DNSH/EU Taxonomy physical-risk verification + evidence PDFs
- [Sustainability & CSRD](https://talaix.com/sustainability.html): ESRS-oriented evidence packs with an explicit coverage map
- [Supply Chain & EUDR](https://talaix.com/supplychain.html): origin-claim geographic evidence screening
- [Environmental Forensics](https://talaix.com/forensics.html): satellite × claims consistency packs for investigators
- [Academy](https://talaix.com/academy.html): pilot course "Climate Risk Assessment for Financial Institutions" + glossary + evidence briefs (Briefs tab)

## Public APIs (read-only, JSON)

- [Data-source registry](https://talaix.com/api/sources): every data source evaluated — integrated / candidate / rejected
- [Data Observatory](https://talaix.com/api/v2/registry): the full global open-data catalogue (167 datasets — portals, hazard archives, earth observation, climate, environment, energy, evidence), grouped by catalog_group; `?status=` `?hazard=` `?provider_class=` filters
- [Hazard registry](https://talaix.com/api/v2/hazards): registered hazard modules with temporal coverage and sources
- [Frameworks reference](https://talaix.com/api/v2/sustainability/frameworks): CSRD/ESRS, EU Taxonomy, SB 253/261, CSDS coverage map
- [Briefs API](https://talaix.com/api/v2/briefs): published evidence briefs and explainers
- Analysis: `GET /api/v2/analyze?hazard=flood&lat=…&lon=…` · Verification: `GET /api/v2/verification/asset?lat=…&lon=…`
- Seal verification: `GET /api/v2/verify/<code>` for registered documents; `POST /api/v2/verify` with `{payload, code}` for stateless JSON verification

## MCP server (remote tools for AI assistants)

- Endpoint: `POST /api/mcp` — JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable-HTTP style, no SSE in this version.
- Transport: single HTTP request/response; stateless; public read-only.
- Tools exposed:
  `talaix_analyze`, `talaix_verify_asset`, `talaix_insurance_profile`,
  `talaix_mapcheck`, `talaix_briefs`, `talaix_brief`,
  `talaix_sustainability_frameworks`, `talaix_sources`, `talaix_hazards`.
- Each tool description embeds the honesty constraints: screening indicators,
  no loss quantification, no accreditation, unavailable data is declared.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Talaix sells evidence, not accreditation: it is not an ESMA-registered
  external reviewer, does not issue Second Party Opinions, and its Academy
  certificates are Certificates of Completion (not accredited).
- Loss quantification is never provided (no AAL/PML); levels are screening
  indicators unless explicitly labelled validated.
- Contact: info@talaix.com
